proposed_widenings.name: object_creation_spell
proposed_widenings.justification: Wall of Ice creates a persistent physical object (the wall) with per-section AC, HP, damage immunities, and vulnerability. No existing spell family models 'create a damageable object'. The wall is not an ongoing_effect (no persistent operation on a target), not an activation (not instantaneous), not a triggered_reaction, and not an anchored_trigger (it's the primary effect, not a planted response).
proposed_widenings.evidence: The wall is an object that can be damaged and thus breached. It has AC 12 and 30 Hit Points per 10-foot section, and it has Immunity to Cold, Poison, and Psychic damage and Vulnerability to Fire damage.

proposed_widenings.name: on_section_destroyed_window
proposed_widenings.justification: When a wall section reaches 0 HP, a frigid air zone is spawned in that space. No existing window atom handles 'when an object or object-section is destroyed'. post_action_window covers creature actions; rest_window covers rest events. A new window atom is needed for the object-HP-reaches-zero event.
proposed_widenings.evidence: Reducing a 10-foot section of wall to 0 Hit Points destroys it and leaves behind a sheet of frigid air in the space the wall occupied.

proposed_widenings.name: hazard_zone
proposed_widenings.justification: The frigid air left behind is a persistent hazard zone that issues save gates when creatures move through it. It is not concentration-dependent (the caster may drop concentration on the wall while zones persist), it is not a creature attachment, and it is not an AnchoredSignal (which only carries audible/mental payloads, not save+damage effects). A hazard_zone atom is needed to represent 'persistent area that triggers a save gate on first entry per turn'.
proposed_widenings.evidence: A creature moving through the sheet of frigid air for the first time on a turn makes a Constitution saving throw, taking 5d6 Cold damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.

proposed_widenings.name: force_move (in Effect union)
proposed_widenings.justification: When the wall appears and cuts through a creature's space, the creature is pushed to one side—this is a forced movement effect that fires before (and independently of) the save gate. The v4 atom force_move exists in TAXONOMY_atoms_graph.md but is absent from the Effect type union in types.ts.
proposed_widenings.evidence: the creature is pushed to one side of the wall (you choose which side) and makes a Dexterity saving throw

proposed_widenings.name: object_stats (AC, HP per section, immunities, vulnerabilities)
proposed_widenings.justification: The created object requires structured per-section statistics that have no representation in any current surface type. Even if an object_creation family were added, a new ObjectStats sub-type would be needed to carry AC, hpPerSection, immunities (DamageType[]), and vulnerabilities (DamageType[]).
proposed_widenings.evidence: It has AC 12 and 30 Hit Points per 10-foot section, and it has Immunity to Cold, Poison, and Psychic damage and Vulnerability to Fire damage.

notes: The on-appearance DEX save (10d6 cold, half on success) and the slot scaling (+2d6/+1d6 per slot above 6) are mechanically encodable within the existing activation family + linear_per_level DiceAmount. However, those pieces are inseparable from the object-creation and zone-spawning mechanics, so a partial encoding would be dishonest. The frigid air zones are also notable for persisting independently of concentration—their lifecycle is tied to wall-section destruction, not to the caster's concentration state. This independence (effect outliving its parent spell) adds a second structural pressure beyond the missing object-creation family.
